dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: You've come to the right person.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Speak your mind. I'm more than happy to keep you company.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hmm... Though it's too bad we don't have anything to wet our whistles with...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do you like to drink so much, Kaeya?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Well... largely because I like the taste.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: But I can't deny that I also like how it makes me feel.

choices.text: I think I understand what you mean.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Oh really? Just from listening to me describe it? Despite having never tried it yourself?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I have to say, though, that chatting with you is quite intoxicating...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Actually, in much the same way that drinking is.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: So, I suppose... I'm just greedy and want to enjoy both of these pleasures at the same time.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So all in all, I'm just another layer in your cocktail of pleasure?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Hahaha... What an interesting metaphor! I hadn't looked at it from that angle...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Hmm... Your analogy seems largely correct.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Save for one small detail — you, of course, are the main ingredient in said cocktail.

choices.text: So what you mean is, you drink to numb the pain?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Goodness, look at you, leaping to conclusions... Do I look like I've been through that much?

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: I'm quite content with my life right now.
